correctness.rationale: For every integer \(n\geq4\), disjointness across primitive rotation orbits and exclusion of periodic words yields the exact necklace ceiling. A two-case suffix/prefix proof validates the a>=floor(n/3),c<floor(n/3) construction, and a finite geometric sum counts it exactly. Independent direct code checks verify overlap-freeness through n=40 and primitive-necklace coverage through n=25. These computations are supplementary to the all-length proof.

value.rationale: The number of synchronization markers per codeword is a natural fixed-composition design constraint. The theorem determines an exact infinite family, and a simultaneous transversal of every primitive cyclic weight-three class is materially stronger than a known orbit upper bound. Explicit words work uniformly at every length, with a distinct proof for the critical two-marker overlap.
